messages.author: 392487f2b859fd83
messages.subject: Calculate Log Posterior Probability
parts:
Hi everyone,

I'm new to nimble and I want to ask if there is any way to evaluate log posterior probabilities at certain parameter values, like using log_prob in stan.

Thanks,
Harry

messages.author: dd632bd3bbcdd7e9
messages.subject: Re: Calculate Log Posterior Probability
parts:
Hi Harry,
Thanks for the posting and glad to hear you're trying nimble.
The model (returned by nimbleModel, and possibly compiled via compileNimble) is an object.  You can set values in it using typical R syntax, like
my_model$beta <- some_vector_of_values
and then you can calculate the sum of log probabilities using the current values in the model by
my_model$calculate()
and you can control which parts of the model are included in the calculation using arguments to calculate().
If you want to do it more systematically across many parameter values, and want those steps to be compiled, you can learn nimbleFunction programming to do that.
To learn more, please see if you find our User Manual at r-nimble.org to be helpful.  Then come back and let us know more questions.
Perry
